papers.title: Densification behavior and mechanical properties of nanocrystalline TiC reinforced 316L stainless steel composite parts fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Institute of Machinery Manufacturing Technology, China Academy of Engineering Physics, Mianyang 621900, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xianfeng Shen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Machinery Manufacturing Technology, China Academy of Engineering Physics, Mianyang 621900, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是SLM制备TiC增强316L不锈钢复合材料，未涉及生物医学植入物的具体需求如多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures for stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究纳米TiC增强316L不锈钢复合材料的SLM致密化行为及力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化技术制备不同TiC含量的复合材料，分析工艺参数对致密度和微观结构的影响。
summary_zh.result: 添加TiC提高了硬度和强度，但延伸率有所下降。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量、微观结构观察和拉伸测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the densification behavior and mechanical properties of nanocrystalline TiC reinforced 316L stainless steel composites fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate composites with varying TiC content, and the effects of processing parameters on densification and microstructure were analyzed.
summary_en.result: Addition of TiC increased hardness and strength but reduced ductility.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through density measurements, microstructural observation, and tensile testing.

papers.title: Inferomedial Hip Center Decreases Failure Rates in Cementless Total Hip Arthroplasty for Crowe II and III Hip Dysplasia

corresponding_authors.name: William L. Griffin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: OrthoCarolina Hip and Knee Center, Charlotte, NC

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床结局研究，未涉及股骨近端应力/应变或微动等生物力学建模内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study with no FE modeling, stress/strain quantification, micromotion analysis, or implant-bone interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究髋臼杯放置位置对Crowe II/III型髋关节发育不良全髋置换失败率的影响。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析临床病例，比较内下髋中心与传统髋中心的失败率。
summary_zh.result: 内下髋中心显著降低失败率。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether inferomedial placement of the hip center reduces failure rates compared to traditional placement in cementless THA for Crowe II/III dysplasia.
summary_en.method: Retrospective clinical review comparing failure rates between inferomedial and traditional hip center positions.
summary_en.result: Inferomedial hip center was associated with significantly lower failure rates.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up data from a patient cohort.

papers.title: Total hip arthroplasty following Girdlestone arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Faculty of Medicine, Saga University, Nabeshima 5-1-1, Saga, 849-8501, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Motoki Sonohata
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Faculty of Medicine, Saga University, Nabeshima 5-1-1, Saga, 849-8501, Japan. Electronic address: epc9719@yahoo.co.jp

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅报告临床病例，未涉及任何生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical case series on total hip arthroplasty after Girdlestone procedure, with no finite element analysis, no micromotion or stress shielding quantification, and no computational modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估Girdlestone术后全髋关节置换术的临床效果。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性病例分析，收集患者术后随访数据。
summary_zh.result: 报道了手术成功率、并发症及功能恢复结果。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访数据验证手术效果。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate clinical outcomes of total hip arthroplasty performed after prior Girdlestone arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective case series with clinical follow-up and outcome assessment.
summary_en.result: Reported surgical success, complication rates, and functional recovery.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up data provided empirical validation of outcomes.
